name: Penpot
description: Open source design and prototyping platform.
summary: Penpot supports responsible AI use, but AI-assisted contributions—including issues and pull requests—must meet quality and accuracy standards and be carefully reviewed and verified by a human before submission. Unreviewed AI-generated code is not accepted, and contributions that fall short may be rejected or closed without detailed review.

If AI-assisted content is used, it must be carefully reviewed and verified by a human before submission.
- Submit AI-generated code without human review.

otherRules.description: For Claude Code 2.1.277 and later, contributors relying on the AGENTS.md fallback must not keep CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in the checkout because those files hide Penpot's guidance.

quotes.quote:
Claude Code reads `AGENTS.md` from 2.1.277, but only in a
 project that has no instruction file of its own, so keep no `CLAUDE.md`,
 `.claude/CLAUDE.md` or `CLAUDE.local.md` in your checkout: any one of them
 hides this repository's guidance from your session.

otherRules.description: The guide prescribes a per-clone skill link or skills installation for Claude Code, and a temporary AGENTS.md-to-CLAUDE.md symlink below version 2.1.277 or on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry installations without the fallback.

quotes.quote:
Skills still load from
 `.claude/skills` alone, so link it once per clone with
 `mkdir -p .claude && ln -s ../.agents/skills .claude/skills`, or with
 `npx skills add ./.agents/skills --agent claude-code`.

Below 2.1.277, and
 on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry where the fallback has not arrived, add
 `ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md` and remove it once your client has the
 feature.

otherRules.description: Personal agent instructions, personal skills and personal Claude steering belong in AGENTS.local.md, .agents/local/skills/ and .claude/rules/*.md respectively.

quotes.quote:
Personal instructions belong in `AGENTS.local.md`, personal
 skills in `.agents/local/skills/`, and personal Claude steering in
 `.claude/rules/*.md`, which Claude loads beside the project instructions
 without switching the fallback off.

otherRules.description: Contributions that fail the stated quality, accuracy, human-oversight or review standards may be rejected or closed without detailed review or a reply.
